findings.evidence: grep `apply Prod.ext` returns these 9 sites; each is followed by `change` or by a `simpa only [toCoverAut_apply]`/`[projection_apply]` round-trip.

findings.issue: Equality of compatible lifts is proved by hand as `apply Subtype.ext; apply Prod.ext` plus `change`/`simpa [toCoverAut_apply]`/`simpa [projection_apply]` in 9 places: Character.lean:65,71,184,266,310 and Equiv.lean:40,46,82,145. summary: Across the four CompatibleLifts files, 26 `change` steps have no comment and rely on how subtypes, products and equivalence coercions happen to unfold. The same two-part equality proof is repeated in 9 places instead of being stated once as an extensionality lemma.
